```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(nlmixr2lib)
library(PKNCA)
library(rxode2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Model and source

* Citation: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("Shuai_2026_chikusetsusaponinIVa_rat"))$reference`
* Description: `r rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("Shuai_2026_chikusetsusaponinIVa_rat"))$description`
* Article: <https://doi.org/10.3390/ph19050749> (open access; supplementary
  Tables S6-S8 at <https://www.mdpi.com/article/10.3390/ph19050749/s1>)

Chikusetsusaponin IVa (CS-IVa) is an oleanane-type triterpenoid saponin from
*Panax japonicus* (C42H66O14, MW 795.0 g/mol). Shuai 2026 compared its
non-compartmental PK in normal and myocardial ischemia/reperfusion-injured
(MI/RI) rats and then re-evaluated twelve candidate compartmental models for
the MI/RI group in Phoenix WinNonlin (Supplementary Table S6). The selected
model is a one-compartment model with first-order absorption, no lag time and
unweighted least squares. The paper then linked this model to an empirical
effect compartment to describe the delay between plasma CS-IVa and the
CK-MB-derived response, choosing ke0 = 0.001 1/min from a sensitivity grid
(Table S8).

# Population

Male specific-pathogen-free Sprague-Dawley rats weighing 200 +/- 20 g
(Section 4.2). MI/RI was induced by 30 min ligation of the left anterior
descending coronary artery followed by reperfusion, and CS-IVa 15 mg/kg was
given intraperitoneally (10 mL/kg, DMSO <= 1% in saline) at the onset of
reperfusion. The MI/RI-15 mg/kg PK group had n = 8 rats sampled over
0-1440 min (Section 4.5). Normal rats at 7.5, 15 and 30 mg/kg (n = 8 each)
were analysed by NCA only and have no compartmental model.

The compartmental fit used the group-mean profile, not individual data:
WinNonlin's AIC = n ln(SSR) + 2p reproduces the Table S6 value of -18.2736
only with n = 13 observations and p = 3 parameters, and the SBC
(-16.5788) then follows exactly. The model therefore has no between-animal
variability.

# Source trace

| Element | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Structure: 1-compartment, first-order absorption, no lag | -- | Section 2.4; Table S6 model 1 |
| `lka` (K01) | 0.01518 1/min | Table S7, full-data row |
| `lcl` (CL/F) | 0.03589 L/min/kg | Table S7, full-data row |
| `lvc` (V/F) | 5.4017 L/kg | Table S7, full-data row |
| `lke0` (ke0, fixed) | 0.001 1/min | Section 2.5; Table S8; Figure 6C |
| Effect compartment `d/dt(effect) = ke0 (Cc - effect)` | -- | Section 2.5 and Supplementary S7 (classical effect compartment) |
| Residual error: additive (unweighted least squares) | -- | Table S6 model 1, weighting 'Unweighted' |
| `addSd` | 0.1243 mg/L | Derived: sqrt(SSR / (n - p)) = sqrt(0.154555 / 10) with SSR from Table S6 and n = 13 from its AIC |
| Dose and route | 15 mg/kg IP | Section 4.2, 4.5 |
| Model-predicted Cmax, Tmax, AUC (check values) | 1.4597 mg/L, 96.81 min, 417.99 min*mg/L | Table S7, full-data row |
| Observed mean profile | 13 points, 5-1440 min | Figure 5A (digitised by the maintainers) |
| NCA in MI/RI rats (comparison) | Cmax 1.52 mg/L, Tmax 54.38 min, AUC0-t 706.22, AUC0-inf 717.20 min*mg/L, t1/2 238.66 min | Table 2 |

# Typical-value simulation

```{r model}
mod <- readModelDb("Shuai_2026_chikusetsusaponinIVa_rat")
ui <- rxode2::rxode(mod)
th <- ui$theta
ka <- exp(th[["lka"]])
cl <- exp(th[["lcl"]])
vc <- exp(th[["lvc"]])
kel <- cl / vc
dose <- 15 # mg/kg

# Paper's sampling grid, read from Figure 5A, plus a fine grid for plotting
t_paper <- c(5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 360, 720, 1440)
t_fine <- sort(unique(c(seq(0, 1440, by = 2), t_paper)))

ev <- rxode2::et(amt = dose, cmt = "depot") |>
  rxode2::et(t_fine, cmt = "central")
sim <- rxode2::rxSolve(
  mod, ev,
  returnType = "data.frame", rtol = 1e-10, atol = 1e-12
)
sim <- sim[sim$time %in% t_fine, ]
```

## Solver identity against the closed form

The one-compartment first-order-absorption solution is known in closed form,
so the ODE solve must reproduce it to integrator precision.

```{r closed_form}
closed_form <- function(t) {
  dose * ka / (vc * (ka - kel)) * (exp(-kel * t) - exp(-ka * t))
}
cf <- closed_form(sim$time)
rel_err <- abs(sim$Cc - cf)[sim$time > 0] / max(cf)
# Measured ~1e-10 relative to Cmax with rtol 1e-10 / atol 1e-12.
stopifnot(max(rel_err) < 1e-7)
max(rel_err)
```

## Model-predicted exposure against Supplementary Table S7

Table S7 reports, for the full data set and for each of the eight
leave-one-rat-out refits, the parameter estimates together with the
model-predicted Cmax, Tmax and AUC. Solving the packaged model with each row's
parameters must reproduce that row's secondary parameters, which checks the
structure, the units and the transcription of all 27 parameter values at once.

```{r table_s7}
s7 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~dataset,     ~V,     ~K01,    ~CL,     ~AUC,   ~Cmax,  ~Tmax,
  "Full data",  5.4017, 0.01518, 0.03589, 417.99, 1.4597, 96.81,
  "Without R1", 5.1002, 0.01532, 0.03479, 431.11, 1.5364, 95.18,
  "Without R2", 5.9297, 0.01717, 0.03586, 418.35, 1.4343, 93.84,
  "Without R3", 6.1685, 0.01645, 0.03531, 424.77, 1.3843, 98.42,
  "Without R4", 5.2081, 0.01323, 0.03643, 411.75, 1.4088, 102.23,
  "Without R5", 5.3837, 0.01601, 0.03588, 418.02, 1.4912, 93.78,
  "Without R6", 5.6574, 0.01653, 0.03584, 418.49, 1.4611, 94.05,
  "Without R7", 5.0520, 0.01377, 0.03653, 410.64, 1.4566, 98.49,
  "Without R8", 4.7495, 0.01336, 0.03605, 416.05, 1.5012, 97.97
)

t_dense <- seq(0, 1440, by = 0.01)
ev_dense <- rxode2::et(amt = dose, cmt = "depot") |>
  rxode2::et(t_dense, cmt = "central")

s7_check <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(s7)), function(i) {
  r <- s7[i, ]
  s <- rxode2::rxSolve(
    mod, ev_dense,
    params = c(lka = log(r$K01), lcl = log(r$CL), lvc = log(r$V)),
    returnType = "data.frame", rtol = 1e-10, atol = 1e-12
  )
  data.frame(
    dataset = r$dataset,
    Cmax_paper = r$Cmax,
    Cmax_model = max(s$Cc),
    Tmax_paper = r$Tmax,
    Tmax_model = s$time[which.max(s$Cc)],
    AUC_paper = r$AUC,
    # AUC0-inf of a linear model is Dose / (CL/F)
    AUC_model = dose / r$CL
  )
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cmax_pct = 100 * (Cmax_model / Cmax_paper - 1),
    Tmax_pct = 100 * (Tmax_model / Tmax_paper - 1),
    AUC_pct = 100 * (AUC_model / AUC_paper - 1)
  )

s7_check |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(Cmax_model, Tmax_model, AUC_model), ~ signif(.x, 5)),
    dplyr::across(c(Cmax_pct, Tmax_pct, AUC_pct), ~ round(.x, 3))
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "Data set" = dataset,
    "Cmax paper (mg/L)" = Cmax_paper, "Cmax model (mg/L)" = Cmax_model,
    "Tmax paper (min)" = Tmax_paper, "Tmax model (min)" = Tmax_model,
    "AUC paper (min*mg/L)" = AUC_paper, "AUC model (min*mg/L)" = AUC_model,
    "Cmax % diff" = Cmax_pct, "Tmax % diff" = Tmax_pct, "AUC % diff" = AUC_pct
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

# Deterministic: every row agrees to the rounding of the printed parameters
# (largest deviation measured 0.02%); a mis-typed digit moves a row by
# percent.
stopifnot(
  nrow(s7_check) == 9L,
  max(abs(s7_check$Cmax_pct)) < 0.1,
  max(abs(s7_check$Tmax_pct)) < 0.1,
  max(abs(s7_check$AUC_pct)) < 0.1
)
```

## Replicating Figure 5A

The observed mean concentrations below were digitised by the maintainers from
Figure 5A. Their sum of squared residuals against the packaged model is
compared with the SSR printed for model 1 in Table S6 (0.154555).

```{r figure5a}
fig5a_obs <- data.frame(
  time = t_paper,
  Cc = c(0.25, 0.51, 0.62, 0.91, 1.02, 1.47, 1.24, 1.50, 1.19, 0.98, 0.30, 0.09, 0.04)
)
pred_at_obs <- sim$Cc[match(fig5a_obs$time, sim$time)]
ssr_digitised <- sum((fig5a_obs$Cc - pred_at_obs)^2)
ssr_digitised
# Digitising error in 13 points is the only source of difference.
stopifnot(abs(ssr_digitised / 0.154555 - 1) < 0.10)

ggplot(sim, aes(time, Cc)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = fig5a_obs, colour = "red", shape = 1, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (min)", y = "CS-IVa plasma concentration (mg/L)",
    caption = "Replicates Figure 5A of Shuai 2026 (MI/RI rats, 15 mg/kg IP)."
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Residual-error band

The model has no between-animal variability, so the only stochastic element
is the additive residual error derived from the Table S6 SSR. The band below
shows 200 replicate mean profiles.

```{r vpc}
rxode2::rxSetSeed(20260513)
ev_vpc <- rxode2::et(amt = dose, cmt = "depot") |>
  rxode2::et(t_paper, cmt = "central")
vpc <- rxode2::rxSolve(mod, ev_vpc, nStud = 200, returnType = "data.frame")
vpc_sum <- vpc[vpc$time > 0, ] |>
  dplyr::group_by(time) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    p05 = quantile(sim, 0.05), p50 = quantile(sim, 0.5), p95 = quantile(sim, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(vpc_sum, aes(time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p05, ymax = p95), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = p50), colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(data = fig5a_obs, aes(y = Cc), colour = "red", shape = 1, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (min)", y = "CS-IVa plasma concentration (mg/L)",
    caption = "5th-95th percentile of 200 replicate profiles; red: Figure 5A means."
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# PKNCA validation

The model profile is sampled on the paper's 13-point schedule (plus the
pre-dose sample) and analysed with PKNCA, then compared with the MI/RI-15 mg/kg
column of Table 2.

```{r pknca}
conc <- sim[sim$time %in% c(0, t_paper), ] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Cc)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(id = 1L, treatment = "MI/RI 15 mg/kg") |>
  dplyr::select(id, treatment, time, Cc)
stopifnot(any(conc$time == 0))
doses <- data.frame(id = 1L, treatment = "MI/RI 15 mg/kg", time = 0, amt = dose)

o_conc <- PKNCA::PKNCAconc(conc, Cc ~ time | treatment + id)
o_dose <- PKNCA::PKNCAdose(doses, amt ~ time | treatment + id)
intervals <- data.frame(
  start = 0, end = 1440,
  cmax = TRUE, tmax = TRUE, auclast = TRUE, aucinf.obs = TRUE, half.life = TRUE
)
nca <- PKNCA::pk.nca(PKNCA::PKNCAdata(o_conc, o_dose, intervals = intervals))

published <- data.frame(
  treatment = "MI/RI 15 mg/kg",
  cmax = 1.52, tmax = 54.38, auclast = 706.22, aucinf.obs = 717.20,
  half.life = 238.66
)
cmp <- nlmixr2lib::ncaComparisonTable(
  simulated = nca,
  reference = published,
  by = "treatment",
  units = c(
    cmax = "mg/L", tmax = "min", auclast = "min*mg/L",
    aucinf.obs = "min*mg/L", half.life = "min"
  ),
  tolerance_pct = 20
)
knitr::kable(cmp)
```

```{r nca_footnote, results = "asis"}
fn <- attr(cmp, "footnote")
if (!is.null(fn)) cat(fn)
```

Only Cmax agrees with Table 2. The other differences come from the source, not
from the transcription:

* **The fitted profile is not the Table 2 profile.** AUC is linear in the
  data, so the mean of the individual AUC0-t values in Table 2 (706.22
  min*mg/L) must equal the trapezoidal AUC of the mean profile on the same
  grid. The digitised Figure 5A means, to which the model was fitted, give a
  much smaller value (below), and the Figure 6A means differ from both.
* **The terminal phase.** The observed mean at 1440 min (about 0.04 mg/L)
  sits far above the model (below 0.001 mg/L), so the NCA half-life
  (238.66 min) and AUC0-inf reflect a slow tail or secondary rise that the
  one-compartment fit does not carry; the model's half-life is ln(2)/kel.
* **Tmax.** Table 2 reports the mean of individual Tmax values (54.38 min).
  The model's continuous-time Tmax is the Table S7 value (96.81 min); on the
  sampling grid PKNCA reports the nearest sampled time, 90 min.

```{r source_consistency}
fig5a_auc <- PKNCA::pk.calc.auc.last(
  conc = c(0, fig5a_obs$Cc), time = c(0, fig5a_obs$time)
)
data.frame(
  quantity = c(
    "Trapezoidal AUC0-1440 of digitised Figure 5A means",
    "Model AUC0-inf, Dose / (CL/F)",
    "Table 2 AUC0-t, MI/RI 15 mg/kg",
    "Model half-life ln(2) / kel (min)",
    "Table 2 half-life (min)"
  ),
  value = signif(c(fig5a_auc, dose / cl, 706.22, log(2) / kel, 238.66), 4)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
# The fitted data and Table 2 disagree by more than a third, which is why the
# AUC comparison above is not used as a gate.
stopifnot(fig5a_auc < 0.75 * 706.22)
```

# Exploratory effect compartment

Shuai 2026 attached an effect compartment to this PK model to describe the
counterclockwise hysteresis between plasma CS-IVa and the CK-MB-derived
response (Figure 6B), selecting ke0 = 0.001 1/min (equilibration half-life
693 min) as the best-fitting converged value of the grid in Table S8. The
paper does not report the function or the parameters linking the effect-site
concentration to the response, so the packaged model outputs the effect-site
concentration `Ce` only.

```{r effect}
ggplot(sim, aes(time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Cc, colour = "Plasma (Cc)")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Ce, colour = "Effect site (Ce), ke0 = 0.001 1/min")) +
  labs(x = "Time (min)", y = "CS-IVa (mg/L)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ce_peak_time <- sim$time[which.max(sim$Ce)]
c(ce_peak_time = ce_peak_time, ce_max = max(sim$Ce))
# The effect site lags plasma: its peak follows the plasma Tmax by hours.
stopifnot(ce_peak_time > 3 * sim$time[which.max(sim$Cc)])
```

The effect-site profile does not match the x-axis of Figure 6C, which shows
`Ce` rising monotonically to about 0.04 mg/L at 1440 min. With ke0 = 0.001
1/min and the Table S7 parameters, `Ce` peaks near
`r round(max(sim$Ce), 2)` mg/L at about `r ce_peak_time` min and has fallen
to `r signif(sim$Ce[sim$time == 1440], 2)` mg/L by 1440 min. The Table S8
footnote states that small `Ce` values in the Phoenix screenshots were read
"according to the scientific notation implied by the corresponding plot
scale", so the Figure 6C axis cannot be taken at face value; the PK input used
for Figure 6C is also not stated. This difference is not resolved.

# Assumptions and deviations

* **No between-animal variability.** The model was fitted to the 13-point
  group-mean profile (n = 13 is implied by the Table S6 AIC and SBC), so it has
  no IIV.
* **Residual error derived, not printed.** Unweighted least squares is an
  additive error model; its SD, 0.1243 mg/L, was computed as
  sqrt(SSR / (n - p)) from the Table S6 SSR (0.154555), n = 13 and p = 3.
* **Units.** Doses are per kilogram (mg/kg) and volumes and clearances per
  kilogram (L/kg, L/min/kg), as in the paper; the `central` and `depot` states
  hold mg/kg.
* **Effect compartment only.** ke0 was chosen from a grid and is encoded as
  fixed. The PD function linking `Ce` to the CK-MB response, its parameters,
  the integrated PK/PD fit in Supplementary Figure S3 and the GAT, LSTM and
  MLP predictors were not reported numerically and are not included.
* **Normal rats.** Only NCA was reported for normal rats (Table 2); there is
  no compartmental model for them.
* **Source inconsistency.** The mean profile in Figure 5A, the profile in
  Figure 6A and the Table 2 AUC values are mutually inconsistent (see the
  PKNCA section). The packaged model reproduces the parameters and the
  model-predicted quantities that the paper reports (Table S7).
* **Errata.** No correction notice was found in Europe PMC on 2026-11-13.
